'''''Blue''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
''Blue'' was present at [[RS-32]], an [[XQ4 Platform]] which was housing [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] technology used by the Rebels. After an [[Defense of ZA-13|unsuccessful]] raid on [[ZA-13]], [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]], tracked down the raid to the station and [[Battle of RS-32|attacked]] the station. When the station's shields were down, RS-32 called for reinforcements and launched [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] and the transport ''Blue'' carrying [[Officer/Legends|Officers]]. However, before the transport could escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]], [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] intercepted and disabled the transport allowing it to be boarded and sent to [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Sceltor]]''
